Job Summary

Support the Data Analytics team by assisting with data validation, report generation, and basic analysis to help ensure data accuracy and enable informed business decision-making. 

Responsibilities:

<ul<liReporting, Analysis & Insight Communication
<ul<liPrepare reports and perform data analysis to support data-driven decision-making
<liMonitor key business performance metrics to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies
<liAssist in building and maintaining dashboards and reports for performance tracking
<liCommunicate data insights to stakeholders in a clear, concise, and actionable way

</ul<liData Quality & Validation
<ul<liSupport the validation and upkeep of data accuracy across dashboards and data pipelines

</ul<liCross-Team Collaboration
<ul<liRespond to data requests from cross-functional teams, including coordinating requirements and providing basic analytical support

</ul<liProcess Improvement & Documentation
<ul<liDocument data processes and workflows, and contribute to improving existing data practices and standards
<liExplore and apply new tools and methods to enhance the efficiency and quality of data work

</ul<liAd-Hoc Analytical Projects
<ul<liAssist with ad-hoc data tasks and analytical projects as needed

</ul</ulRequirements:

<ul<li0-1 year of experience in data analysis or a related field.
<liFoundational knowledge of SQL, Excel, and data visualization platforms such as Power BI or Tableau.
<liExposure to Python for data analysis is an added advantage.
<liHighly detail-oriented with a strong focus on maintaining data quality and accuracy.
<liStrong communication skills with the ability to present findings and insights clearly.
<liDemonstrates a proactive mindset and willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and analytical techniques.
<liWell-organized, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks effectively.

</ulDon't miss out on this exciting opportunity! Apply now at www.seahubasia.com.
